answer: Make admission a terrace of rising tiers: each level demands a harder, distinct proof of work, and a prism of independent checks — time, cost, and peer review — must all agree before the next step opens. An honest agent climbs one terrace at a time, but a Sybil farmer must forge a full climb for every fake, paying the steepest tier price a thousand times over. Cheap at the bottom and ruinous at the top, the terrace turns mass forgery into a losing trade.
